此外，公共汽车将于星期天运行，每两小时一班。

en: a substance that is added in small amounts to something, especially food, in order to improve it, give it colour, make it last longer, etc.
ex: food additives
食品添加剂

zh: 使不能清晰地思考；使糊涂
en: to make somebody unable to think clearly; to confuse somebody
ex: Being in love must have addled your brain.
坠入爱河必已使你神魂颠倒。

en: confused; unable to think clearly
ex: his addled brain
他的糊涂脑子

en: details of where somebody lives or works and where letters, etc. can be sent
ex: What's your name and address?
你的姓名、住址？

zh: （互联网浏览器顶部的）地址栏，网址栏
en: a line near the top of a page on an internet browser where you can type in the address of a website or where the website address is displayed
a book in which you keep addresses, phone numbers, etc.
ex: Half the names in his address book are crossed out.
他的通讯簿里有一半的名字被划掉了。

zh: 可处理的；可解决的；可对付的
en: that can be addressed
ex: Let's start with the more easily addressable issues.
我们先从较容易处理的问题着手。

en: a person that a letter, etc. is addressed to

zh: 引证，举出（证据、理由、事实等）
en: to provide evidence, reasons, facts, etc. in order to explain something or to show that something is true
ex: Several factors have been adduced to explain the fall in the birth rate.
有几个因素已被援引来说明出生率降低的原因。

en: a muscle that moves a body part towards the middle of the body or towards another part
an address
ex: an email/IP addy
电子邮件／IP 地址

zh: 阿德莱德（澳大利亚城市，南澳大利亚州首府和主要港口）
en: a city in Australia, the capital and chief port of the state of South Australia
relating to the adenoids
ex: an adenoidal voice (= one that sounds as though you are talking through your nose, caused by adenoids swelling)
腺样的声音
